Midnattsol by Fjord Fuzz | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Fjord Fuzz Midnattsol LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description Midnattssol means “midnight sun” — a truly magical thing for those of us up north to look forward to when summer finally returns and the sun barely sets. MIDNATTSSOL is like the final boss of Fuzz Faces and Uni‑Vibes — the most party‑friendly, lovely, and magical circuits of all. It features a host of novel — and more importantly, useful — additions to these classic circuits, forming a simple yet comprehensive final little hômmage before the creator moves on to different designs. Internally switchable options let you choose between classic Uni‑Vibe tones and ReslyTone sounds, as well as Fuzz Face, Zonk II fuzz tones, or an all‑new in‑between mode. On top of that, the phasing section offers deep customization — with 256 possible combinations, to be precise. The real star is the expression control, which dramatically expands the range of this beautiful circuit, unlocking sounds never heard before.
